settings.methodMarkdown:
## The short version
We no longer rely on websites. We use **HTML files** that open straight in your browser, with everything embedded inside the file.

1. Download the file.
2. Open it from your Files app.
3. It opens in a new tab on your device.

[Example: a single-file game](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EL-_EpKERRsWK0hxTDBgmGZUWD3-AGm2/view?usp=sharing)

> [!warning] Status update
> Local HTML files were recently blocked on some devices. We're working on a workaround — until then, use the **Emulator** (it still works).

## Why it works
The district uses Securly. Securly filters websites, but it doesn't filter the contents of HTML files you open yourself. It *can* block `file:///`, but that would also break a lot of normal school work that relies on local files, so it's unlikely to happen.

Most students only use websites that can be blocked. Self-contained HTML files are a different approach entirely.

## What's planned
- Games
- Movies
- Music
- And more

patchnotes.title: Official site launch
patchnotes.body:
The official Green Grass site is live.

- **Game library** with search, categories, favorites and one-click play
- **Green Grass Emulator** — our own HTML runner. Open files, paste code, or load Drive links
- **Live chat** with channels, built right into the site
- **Link Checker** — test whether a site is reachable from your network
- **Patch notes**, the Method guide, and a curated links page
- **Admin dashboard** for managing everything
- First-visit **onboarding** tour

patchnotes.title: Local HTML files blocked
patchnotes.body:
As of recently, local HTML files have been blocked on some devices. We're working on a workaround.

For now, stick to the emulator — it still works.

patchnotes.title: Official site in progress
patchnotes.body: Working on an official site with the game list (auto-embedded with the emulator), the method, unblocked and useful sites, an embedded chatroom, patch notes, an administration dashboard, onboarding, a link block checker, and more.

patchnotes.title: Chatroom beta — [GG] C-App
patchnotes.body:
The chatroom is in beta and working well.

**If errors occur:** open App Data and delete everything in the boxes **except** A1, B1, C1, D1, E1 — and in the messages tab, A1, B1, C1, D1. Then open the site again.

patchnotes.title: Doc edit notifier
patchnotes.body:
Added a script that emails me when the document is edited, plus a Gmail label and filter that sorts those emails, so I can see the latest updates and know when you're active.

[Open the script](https://script.google.com/d/1fYj07cTKtdhB6FHzufMBZrmNkSgUjk7CfNiY69it06PMFsLg2HfcOw2p/edit?usp=sharing) — make a copy, add Drive services, change the email and any settings you want.
